digest.component_or_area: Rebar tracker agent guidance for ChatGPT sessions
propositions: ChatGPT sessions operating in connector-limited environments (lacking local checkout, native rebar binary, tracker worktree access, or network/Gerrit connectivity) cannot create tickets natively and require a documented safe fallback workflow

The fallback mechanism must produce NDJSON payloads conforming to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id as agent-generated UUID4, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and parent_id, which rebar import later ingests idempotently via source_id without hand-authoring raw events

rebar import is the only sanctioned bulk-ingest path; it silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type with no warning/counter-increment in --dry-run mode, detectable via would_create + skipped == total record count comparison, and requires dry-run validation and rebar validate/fsck post-invocation

GitHub repository is a read-only mirror for code; all code changes land through Gerrit; GitHub Issues are not a substitute for the Rebar tracker, and direct GitHub Contents-API writes to the tickets branch are unsafe and non-sanctioned

The capability-check decision rule precisely defines native ticket creation as impossible only when both tracker-worktree access fails AND (network/remote access fails OR native rebar/rebar-mcp binary unavailable); all other capability failures do not trigger the fallback

Guidance must prohibit hand-authoring, modifying, or deleting tracker event files, explain the append-only/optimistic-concurrency invariant, require search-before-create when live tracker is accessible, and remain discoverable from AGENTS.md without bloating startup context
